{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Filter for patients with SEVERE disease
severe_patients = df[df['severity'] == 'severe']

# Identify sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
# Assume -999.0 is the sentinel for missing/invalid data
valid_baseline = severe_patients['biomarker_baseline']

# Filter out sentinel values
valid_baseline = valid_baseline[valid_baseline != -999.0]

# Compute the mean of valid baseline biomarker values
mean_biomarker = valid_baseline.mean()

mean_biomarker"}
